configuration.expiry_not_immediate: Dynamo expires an active request only after it is at least 5s old and a periodic 60s force-expiry tick runs. The resulting release delay is phase-dependent, not fixed at 5s.

evidence_boundary.poll_sleep_purpose: Bounded passive observation only; never used to alter native or Python scheduling order.

expiry_behavior.interpretation: Five seconds is the age guard. Release occurs on a periodic 60-second sweep (or an add-request side effect), so the runner observes for 75 seconds rather than assuming immediate release.
expiry_behavior.mock_lifecycle_boundary: P1/P2 may remain in KVTokenTracker._requests because the CPU mock emits no completion events and Python's production stale tracking TTL is 3600 seconds. This is not used to judge native Dynamo expiry.
